tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Corporate black. The default page ground; also the ink on periwinkle fills. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Corporate white. Headlines and body text on black. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: grey
tokens.usage: Corporate grey. Secondary text on black (6.2:1), metadata, rules in illustrations. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: periwinkle
tokens.usage: Corporate accent. Use sparingly: one fill or highlight per view. Reads as text on black (9.6:1); never as text on white (2.1:1). Same in every theme.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Leave most of it empty.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, code blocks, menus. Set apart from surface by shade plus a `line` border.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of rows, cards and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines (1px). Decorative only; carries no meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; meets 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines, on surface, surface-raised and surface-hover.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, labels, prices, metadata, on surface, surface-raised and surface-hover (4.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selection, active indicator. Pair with on-accent text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (9.6:1). Never white on periwinkle.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and highlighted words, on surface, surface-raised and accent-tint. Light theme uses a deeper periwinkle so it passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet periwinkle ground behind accent-text: tags, selected rows, notices.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset, on every surface (5.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, as text or 1px border on surface; always with a word, never colour alone.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline, one per page. Scale down to 48px on mobile.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Body copy is set in mono at a calm 24px rhythm.
styles.usage: All running text. Keep lines to 64 characters max.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Nav links, buttons, tags, section eyebrows. Always UPPERCASE.

spacing.note: Generous by default: when unsure, take the next step up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight inline gaps, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding, gap between label and title. Mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter, gap between stacked blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and the grid it introduces.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between page sections. The default breathing room.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero top/bottom padding and deliberate empty zones.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for everything: cards, images, inputs, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags and checkboxes only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots and toggles only.
